Spring on B-612 is over. What the colony holds now is what this keeper made of it.
The years record: planted 4 seeds, cut 16 harvests, brought in 1 catch of fish.
The colony ledger closes at 795 cr — solvent, this season, by the keeper's hand.
2 colonists came to know you — 21 heart-units of trust carried across the season.
You sat and talked 8 times;
The alien envoys received no doctrine from this keeper; the frontier remained unanswered.
The festival was attended and claimed 1 time — the bell rang for you.
The colony's thread moved: 4 quests carried to their close.

The bell asks the only question worth asking: What kind of keeper were you?
